devices.label: Brocade G610 32G FC switch
devices.description: Gen 6 Brocade FC SAN switch in 1U: 24 x 32G Fibre Channel ports (licence-enabled in 8-port steps - 8, 16 or 24 active) that autosense 8/16/32G. One 1GbE RJ45 management port and an RS-232 console; no Ethernet data ports.
devices.notes: 32G Fibre Channel is not an allowed speed step, so ports are modelled at the nearest step (25G) with the real 8/16/32G rates in speedCaps. SFP+ cages carry 8/16/32G FC optics only - no copper RJ45 data port on this box; the RJ45 is management.

devices.label: Brocade G720 64G FC switch
devices.description: Gen 7 Brocade FC SAN switch in 1U: 48 x 64G SFP+ ports plus 8 x 2x64G SFP-DD double-density cages, giving 64 line-rate ports (56 cages). Ports autosense 32/64G; one 1GbE RJ45 management port and a mini-USB console.
devices.notes: 64G Fibre Channel is not an allowed speed step, so ports are modelled at the nearest step (40G) with the real 32/64G rates in speedCaps. The 8 SFP-DD cages each carry two 64G links (thus 64 ports from 56 cages); each cage is listed once and the SFP-DD cage is typed sfp28 because the schema has no SFP-DD connector.

devices.label: Cisco MDS 9148S 16G FC switch
devices.description: 1RU 16G Fibre Channel fabric switch: 48 autosensing 2/4/8/16G ports (12, 24 or 48 active per licence), SAN-OS/NX-OS with VSANs and IVR. One 10/100/1000Base-T mgmt0 port and an RJ45 console; no Ethernet data ports.
devices.notes: 16G Fibre Channel is not an allowed speed step, so ports are modelled at the nearest step (10G) with the real 2/4/8/16G rates in speedCaps. MDS 9148S is end-of-sale; the 48-port count is the maximum licensed configuration.

devices.label: Cisco MDS 9124V 64G FC switch
devices.description: 1RU 64G Fibre Channel fabric switch: 24 multispeed 8/16/32/64G ports, expandable in 8-port licence increments (ports 9-12 can be encryption ports). NX-OS with VSANs, IVR, slow-drain detection and NX-API; mgmt0 10/100/1000Base-T and an RJ45 console.
devices.notes: 64G Fibre Channel is not an allowed speed step, so ports are modelled at the nearest step (40G) with the real 32/64G rates in speedCaps. mgmt1 (analytics Ethernet port) exists on the chassis but is documented as not yet supported, so it is not modelled.

devices.label: HPE B-series SN3600B 32G FC switch
devices.description: HPE's OEM Brocade G610: entry-level 1U 32G Fibre Channel switch with 24 x 32G SFP+ ports that autosense 4/8/16/32G, licensed 8 to 24 ports via Ports-on-Demand. One RJ45 1GbE management port and an RS-232 console port.
devices.notes: 32G Fibre Channel is not an allowed speed step, so ports are modelled at the nearest step (25G) with the real 4/8/16/32G rates in speedCaps. Base SKUs ship 8 or 16 ports active; 24 is the chassis maximum.

devices.label: Dell Connectrix DS-6630B 32G FC switch
devices.description: 2U Connectrix B-series (Brocade G630) SAN switch: 96 standard 32G SFP+ ports plus 8 QSFP ICL cages that add 32 more ports, 128 line-rate 32G ports in total. Ports autosense 8/16/32G; 1GbE RJ45 management and a serial console.
devices.notes: Dell's product page states 128 ports total = 96 SFP 32G/s + 8 QSFP (each QSFP = 4 x 32G = 128 Gb/s). 32G FC is modelled at the nearest allowed step (25G) with real rates in speedCaps; the 8 QSFP ICL cages are modelled as 100G (nearest allowed step to their 128 Gb/s aggregate) since the schema has no 4x32G rate.

devices.label: QLogic SANbox 5800V 8G FC switch
devices.description: 1U stackable 8G Fibre Channel switch, 20 x 8G device ports (licensed in 4-port steps from 8) plus 4 always-on 10G stacking ports that upgrade to 20G ISL, 24 ports in total. Backwards compatible with 4G and 2G; stacking scales to 120 device ports across a stack.
devices.notes: 8G Fibre Channel is not an allowed speed step, so device ports are modelled at the nearest step (10G) with the real 2/4/8G rates in speedCaps; the 4 stacking/ISL ports are 10G (20G with the bandwidth-on-demand licence). Source is QLogic data sheet 50902-00 Rev H, still hosted by a reseller because qlogic.com was folded into Marvell - the 5800V itself is long end-of-sale.

devices.label: PowerVault ME5012 iSCSI array (dual controller)
devices.description: 2U12 dual-active-controller block array. Each controller carries four 10/25GbE SFP28 iSCSI host ports and one 1GbE RJ45 management port, so 8 host ports and 2 management ports per array; FC 32G and 12Gb SAS controller options exist.
devices.notes: Connectivity listed per array: 8-port 25GbE iSCSI SFP+ (or 8-port 10Gbase-T, 8-port 32G FC, 8-port 12Gb SAS) plus a 2-port 1GbE management pair - i.e. 4 data + 1 mgmt per controller. Modelled with the 25GbE SFP28 controller; the SFP28 ports downshift to 10G.

devices.label: NetApp AFF A250 entry all-flash array
devices.description: 2U entry-level AFF all-flash system with two active-active controllers. Onboard I/O is 4 x 25GbE SFP28 (2 per controller, 10GbE autoranging) plus 2 x 1GbE RJ45 management ports (e0M, one per controller); PCIe slots take it to 20 x 25GbE or 16 x 32G FC for iSCSI, NVMe/TCP, NVMe/FC and NFS/SMB.
devices.notes: NetApp lists onboard I/O as 4 x 25GbE and 2 x 1GbE management ports per system (per-system totals: 20 x 25GbE / 16 x 32G FC / 4 x 100GbE / 8 x 12Gb SAS once the 4 PCIe slots are populated). Storage-side SAS ports and the cluster-interconnect ports are internal to the HA pair and not modelled.

devices.label: HPE MSA 2062 iSCSI array (dual controller)
devices.description: 2U SFF dual-controller hybrid-flash block array: 8 host ports per array (four per controller) at 10/25GbE iSCSI SFP28 or 1/10GBase-T, with 8/16G FC and 12Gb SAS controller options. Out-of-band management is a 100/1000 Ethernet port per controller plus USB.
devices.notes: QuickSpecs: 2 controllers per array, 8 host ports per array, iSCSI 10/25GbE (SFP) or 1/10GBase-T (RJ-45); management is out-of-band 100/1000 Ethernet, one per controller. Modelled with the 10/25GbE iSCSI SFP28 controller option.

devices.label: PowerStore 500T all-flash array (dual node)
devices.description: 2U two-node all-flash appliance (25 NVMe slots). Each node's embedded module has 2 fixed 10GbE optical ports, a 4-port front-end card (25GbE SFP28, 10GBase-T or 32G FC), a 1GbE RJ45 system management port and a separate service port, plus two I/O module slots: 4 x 10GbE + 8 x 25GbE + 2 management in the modelled configuration.
devices.notes: Per the Hardware Information Guide each embedded module = 1 x 4-port card + 2 fixed 10GbE optical ports + system-management and service RJ-45 LAN connectors (+ 2 I/O module slots per node). Front-end card choice is 4-port 25GbE SFP28, 4-port 10GBase-T or 4-port 16/32G FC; 25GbE modelled. The per-node service port is a support-only interface and is not modelled.

devices.label: Pure Storage FlashArray //X20
devices.description: 3U dual-controller all-NVMe block array. Each controller has 2 x 1/10/25GbE SFP28 host/replication ports and 2 x 1GbE management ports onboard (4 + 4 per array), with three host-I/O card slots per controller for 2-port 32G FC or extra 10/25GbE. Presents iSCSI, NVMe/TCP, FC and NVMe/FC.
devices.notes: Pure data sheet, //X Connectivity: per controller 2 x 1/10/25Gb Ethernet/replication, 2 x 1Gb management ports and 2 x 100GbE DirectFlash shelf ports (the DFS ports are array-internal and not modelled). FC host connectivity comes from optional 2-port 32G FC cards in the three host-I/O slots per controller.
